summary: Frontend regression for Round 1 (CodeCraft) embedded Scratch 3 editor after switching iframe src to https://scratchfoundation.github.io/scratch-gui/. Setup: admin login, PUT /api/competition {start_datetime past, current_round:1}, created student r1test2@test.com/Pass@123 via POST /api/students. Logged in as student, opened /round/1. RESULT: FIX VERIFIED. (1) iframe [data-testid=scratch-iframe] src is exactly https://scratchfoundation.github.io/scratch-gui/; content_frame is accessible, title is 'Scratch 3.0 GUI', body contains real editor UI (Motion/Looks/Sound/Events/Control/Sensing/Operators/Variables/My Blocks palettes, blocks like 'move 10 steps', 'when clicked', costumes/sounds tabs, Scratch cat sprite on stage, canvas rendered). Markers: [class*='blocks']=true, [class*='gui']=true, [class*='stage']=true, hasCanvas=true. Body text contains NO 'Invalid TurboWarp Embed', NO 'refused to connect', NO X-Frame-Options error. Screenshot at /app/test_reports/round1_scratchgui.png confirms visually the full Scratch 3 editor is rendered inside the iframe. (2) 'Open in new tab' (open-scratch-btn), project link input (round1-url) and Submit (round1-submit) are visible; submitting a link produced the toast 'Project link submitted!' via POST /api/rounds/1/submit. (3) Access control preserved: after PUT /api/competition {current_round:0}, /round/1 shows 'Round 1 isn't available' with NO iframe rendered. Cleanup performed: POST /api/rounds/reset, current_round=0, test student deleted.

issues: The loading fallback overlay is at z-0 behind the z-10 iframe. Since scratch-gui loads correctly now, it's a non-issue functionally, but the overlay is effectively invisible and dead UI. Consider removing it or showing it only until an onload signal fires.

critical_code_review_comments: Round1.jsx height math 'calc(100vh - 64px - 65px - 40px)' hardcodes navbar/toolbar/footer heights and will break on responsive wrap of the flex-wrap toolbar. Prefer flexbox flex-1 + min-h-0.
iframe allow attribute lacks 'clipboard-read' (only clipboard-write); Scratch editors often want paste support.
Access-control check in useEffect: initial state allowed=true renders briefly before /competition resolves — consider defaulting allowed=false until fetched.
test_credentials: Admin ranveerajimal9@gmail.com / Bitlogic@2026. Test student r1test2@test.com / Pass@123 (created & deleted).
seed_data_creation: Created student r1test2@test.com then deleted at end. Toggled competition current_round 1 -> 0 with rounds/reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 1 embedded Scratch 3 editor is now fully functional via https://scratchfoundation.github.io/scratch-gui/ static build. Iframe content_frame is same-origin-accessible for testing (title 'Scratch 3.0 GUI', full blocks palette visible, canvas + Scratch cat on stage). Note: correct student create endpoint is POST /api/students (NOT /api/admin/students). Login button label is 'Log In'. Competition PUT accepts partial payload.
rca of the issue: Previous X-Frame-Options / TurboWarp anti-embed issues are both eliminated by using the official Scratch Foundation GitHub Pages build of scratch-gui, which serves the static SPA with no X-Frame-Options, no restrictive frame-ancestors CSP, and no client-side embed detection. The editor loads and runs entirely inside the iframe.
